jobs.title: AI Creative Technologist
jobs.description:
At 22DOGS, we are passionate about creating world\-class visual effects and fostering a collaborative, creative environment. With studios in Milan, Tenerife and Toronto, we bring together top\-tier talent and innovative workflows to deliver exceptional results for film, television, and advertising.
  

We are currently looking for talented Creative Technologists to join our growing team on an initial freelance, fully remote basis. This is an exciting opportunity for someone eager to explore the intersection of art and technology, leveraging cutting\-edge AI and VFX tools to craft innovative visuals that push creative boundaries.
**Job Description**
The Creative Technologist leverages Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) to create, enhance, and integrate visual assets that support the creative vision of Clients and the Visual Effects Supervisor. The Technologist is responsible for the aesthetic integrity, technical reliability, and creative consistency of all AI\-generated imagery delivered for a task or project.
  

Under the guidance of the Head of Department, Department leads and Visual Effect Supervisors, the Creative Technologist produces high\-quality AI\-generated visual assets that meet the project’s creative direction, using a combination of AI\-driven tools, custom nodes and workflows, curated datasets, stills, animated imagery, CG renders, and digitally enhanced elements.  

**Key Responsibilities**  

  

* Generate high\-quality visuals and assets using AI\-driven tools and pipelines, including image generation, model prompting, fine\-tuning, dataset creation, upscaling, and iterative visual exploration.
* Collaborate with Head of Department, supervisors and artists across departments to create and integrate AI\-generated elements into final shots.
* Maintain visual consistency across assigned shots and sequences, ensuring style, colour, quality, and creative intent are aligned.
* Build, adapt, and optimize Generative AI workflows \- particularly within ComfyUI \- along with GenAI tools, and assist in identifying creative and technical solutions.
* Contribute to internal R\&D by testing emerging models, tools, and techniques and sharing findings with the wider team.
* Maintain high standards of visual quality, realism, and production readiness.
  

  

**Required Skills and Qualifications**  

  

  

* Strong working knowledge of GenAI platforms and tools ( such as ComfyUI, image\-to\-image, image\-to\-video, video to video workflows, LoRA training and customization).
* Working knowledge of Compositing in Nuke on film or commercial projects.
* Strong artistic skills in composition, realism, style matching, lighting, and colour grading.
* Ability to work well under pressure, adapt quickly, and meet tight deadlines.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills across departments.
  
  

**What We Offer**  

  

  

* Opportunity to work in a creative, international studio environment.
* Hands\-on experience and mentorship from an experienced HR team.
* Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
* Supportive workplace culture focused on collaboration, growth, and innovation.
  
  

**Why Join Us?**
  

At 22DOGS, you’ll be part of an ambitious and international VFX studio where artistry and innovation meet. We value creativity, teamwork, and continuous learning — offering you the chance to grow your skills, lead exceptional artists, and help shape the future of visual storytelling.
  

**How to Apply**
  

If you’re passionate about VFX and ready to take the next step in your career, — we look forward to meeting you.

jobs.title: Creative Director — Interior Architecture & Design
jobs.description:
**The Role**

We're looking for a **visionary Creative Director** to lead our design voice. You'll set the creative direction across all projects, inspire and **mentor our design team**, and be the face of the Cervo Bianco aesthetic with clients and partners. This is a role for someone who pairs a rare artistic eye with the technical depth and business sense to bring ambitious ideas to life.

**What You'll Do**

* Define and evolve the studio's creative vision and signature design language across every project.
* Lead concept development from first sketch to final installation, making sure every space reflects our standard of excellence.
* Present concepts to high\-net\-worth clients, developers, and brand partners with confidence and storytelling flair.
* Mentor and grow a team of interior architects, designers, and visualizers, building a culture of creativity and accountability.
* Curate materials, finishes, furniture, lighting, and art, and build relationships with artisans, galleries, and luxury suppliers.
* Work closely with architects, engineers, and contractors to protect design intent through execution.
* Balance creative ambition with budgets, timelines, and profitability.
* Shape the studio's brand presence through portfolios, publications, awards, and events

**Who You Are**

* Degree in Interior Design, Interior Architecture, or Architecture.
* **8\+ years** of experience in **luxury interior design**, with at **least 4–5 years in a senior creative or leadership role**.
* A strong portfolio of high\-end residential, hospitality, or commercial projects that shows a distinctive point of view.
* Deep knowledge of spatial planning, materials, joinery, lighting, and craftsmanship.
* Excellent command of AutoCAD is essential, along with solid working knowledge of 3ds Max, V\-Ray, and other visualization tools (such as SketchUp, Rhino, Revit, and the Adobe Creative Suite) to guide and review the team's technical and rendering work.
* A natural leader who inspires people rather than manages them.
* Polished, articulate, and comfortable in front of demanding clients.
* Culturally curious, with a sharp eye on art, fashion, architecture, and global design movements.

**Bonus Points**

* Published work or industry awards.
* Experience with international projects or luxury hospitality brands.
* Experience designing custom furniture or product collections.
* **Fluent in Italian and English;** additional languages are a plus.

Retribuzione: €2\.000,00 \- €3\.000,00 al mese

Benefit:

* Bevande gratis
* Computer aziendale

Istruzione:

* Laurea magistrale (o specialistica) (Preferenziale)

Esperienza:

* luxuary interior design: 8 anni (Obbligatorio)
* senior creative or leadership role: 4 anni (Obbligatorio)

Lingua:

* Inglese (Obbligatorio)
* Italiano (Obbligatorio)

Disponibilità a viaggiare:

* 50% (Preferenziale)

Sede di lavoro: In presenza
